script:
Three weeks after my diet ended, I stood on the scale in my kitchen, and the number was back. Same jeans, same mirror, and I felt like I had failed at the one thing I promised myself.

That night I sat on the edge of the bed in my jeans, staring at the ceiling, too ashamed to tell anyone I was back at the start.

Then one morning I read something that changed everything. A study had followed people for a full year after their diet, and their hunger was still louder, their fullness still weaker. My body was not betraying me. It was protecting me.

So I started again, smaller this time. Protein at breakfast, a walk after dinner, and the measuring cup back on the counter where I could see it.

Three months later the jeans fit again, and this time I knew why it would hold. Save this for the day you want to quit.
